title: Implement high-level Odin generator package
description:
Implement odin/llama/llama.odin providing idiomatic Odin types and procedures: Device_Info, Device_Kind, devices() -> []Device_Info for hardware discovery, Generator_Config (model path, layers, speculative settings), Llama_Generator struct (encapsulating model, context, batch, sampler chain), generator_new(cfg) -> (^Llama_Generator, string), and generator_generate(g, prompt, turns, max_tokens, stop_seqs, cancel_flag, on_token, on_progress, user_data) supporting streaming tokens and cancellation.

Acceptance Criteria:
- odin/llama/llama.odin exposes idiomatic Device_Info and devices() helper
- Llama_Generator properly initializes model, context, and samplers via generator_new
- generator_generate streams generated tokens via callback and handles stop sequences and cancellation
- Proper resource cleanup procs implemented
